title: Seasoned-Site Lowering of the Lower End — Commercial Natural Gas Supply Shortfall Corrections
content:
**Rule.** In the correction of a Commercial Natural Gas Supply swing shortfall charge line, the lower end is lowered for seasoned sites:

- an agreement with at least 24 energy charge lines on file that already carries a renewal loyalty credit line has its billed lower end lowered by 10 percent of the monthly contract volume;
- an agreement with at least 24 energy charge lines on file and no renewal loyalty credit line has it lowered by 5 percent of the monthly contract volume;
- any other agreement keeps the billed lower end.

The reduction is rounded half up to a whole therm and is taken off the billed lower end, the lower end of the band the shortfall line was billed against. The monthly contract volume is the contracted annual therms divided by 12, rounded half up to a whole therm. Both counts of lines are taken from the agreement's own bill lines.

## Condition table

| Energy charge lines on file | Renewal loyalty credit line on the agreement | Reduction of the billed lower end |
|---|---|---|
| 24 or more | Yes | 10 percent of the monthly contract volume |
| 24 or more | No | 5 percent of the monthly contract volume |
| 23 or fewer | Either | None |

## Worked figures (hypothetical monthly contract volume 1,255 therms, billed lower end 1,004 therms)

- 10 percent of 1,255 is 125.5, rounded half up to 126 therms; the lowered lower end is 1,004 less 126, that is 878 therms.
- 5 percent of 1,255 is 62.75, rounded half up to 63 therms; the lowered lower end is 941 therms.
- An agreement with 23 energy charge lines keeps 1,004 therms, whether or not it carries a renewal loyalty credit line.
